scope: Each Mech's live GitHub Pages site as checked on October 25, 2026, between 18:00 and 22:20 UTC, independently of the repository pins used by the census. One AI reviewer per site reassessed the 24 earlier catalogue features in an isolated headless Chrome profile at 390 and 1,280 px: identifier and label searches, filters, URL restoration, theme persistence across pages, horizontal overflow and deliberately aborted data requests where applicable. Corpus-wide static audits of the committed or deployed pages supplied the corpus-wide counts in the notes, and the ten newly catalogued features were rated in a separate pass on all fourteen sites between 21:37 and 22:20 UTC; AntibioticMech, CellStructureMech and TraitMech had redeployed by then, so their ratings for those ten features describe the later deployment. Notes name the sampled routes rather than claiming an exhaustive check of every record, and ratings were not independently re-tested. Each deployed_revision identifies the deployment whose latest status was verified as successful and which that site's review of the 24 earlier features observed; later deployments may differ.

search.label: Search
search.definition: A labeled text search over the whole published corpus, tested with a known identifier and a known label.
search.criteria: Present: it finds records by identifier and by label, shows how many match, and every match can be opened. Partial: results are capped with no route to the rest, no match count is shown, identifiers are not searchable, or search works only within one category.

facets.label: Filters
facets.definition: Filter controls on record properties, with a way to clear them.
facets.criteria: Present: at least one filter on a record property in the main record listing, with a reset. Partial: filters only on a map or plot page, or a single selector without a reset. A free-text box is a search, not a filter.

result_counts.label: Result counts
result_counts.definition: A count of matching records that updates with search and filters, distinct from the total.

sorting.label: Sorting
sorting.definition: The reader can change the sort order of a listing.
sorting.criteria: Present: a sort control or sortable column headings.

shareable_state.label: Linkable search
shareable_state.definition: Search and filter state is kept in the URL, so a filtered view can be bookmarked and restores on load.
shareable_state.criteria: Partial: some state, such as a facet or a selected record, restores from the URL but the main search does not. Does not apply: the site has no search or filters.

full_catalogue.label: Complete catalog
full_catalogue.definition: Every record the site counts is reachable from it, by listing, pagination, shards or lazy loading.
full_catalogue.criteria: Partial: some records the site counts cannot be reached from its pages.

site_search.label: Search from any page
site_search.definition: The landing page and record pages carry a search box that opens the main listing with the query applied.
site_search.criteria: Present: both the landing page and record pages hand off a query that the listing restores and applies. Partial: only one of them, or the query arrives but is not applied. Does not apply: the site has no listing search.

record_pages.label: Record pages
record_pages.definition: Each record has its own stable, linkable URL.

term_links.label: Term links
term_links.definition: Ontology terms show a readable label beside the CURIE, and the CURIE links to a resolver.
term_links.criteria: Present: the record's own grounding and the terms in its main sections are labeled and linked; a few minor prefixes may be plain text. Partial: a whole main section of terms is unlinked, unlabeled or broken, or the record's own identifier does not resolve for many records.

evidence.label: Evidence links
evidence.definition: References (PMID, DOI or URL) shown on record pages are linked.
evidence.criteria: Partial: references are plain text, or only a minority of the records that cite something link it.

review_status.label: Curation status
review_status.definition: Each record shows its curation or review status.

curation_history.label: Curation history
curation_history.definition: The record view shows its curation events: what changed, when and by whom.

source_link.label: Source link
source_link.definition: The record view links to the record's own source file in the GitHub repository.
source_link.criteria: Partial: the file is named as plain text, or only the repository root is linked.

domain_view.label: Domain visual
domain_view.definition: A view suited to the domain, such as a structure or embedding map, a pathway or causal diagram, an interaction network or a lineage.
domain_view.criteria: Partial: the visual exists but is broken for readers.

cross_mech_links.label: Cross-Mech links
cross_mech_links.definition: Record views link to specific records in sibling Mechs or in kg-microbe.
cross_mech_links.criteria: Partial: related records are named as plain text, or the links are broken.

text_map.label: Text embedding map
text_map.definition: A map of the corpus projected from text embeddings (the fleet's shared embedding sets), with search and filters, where clicking a point opens its record.
text_map.criteria: Present: the map renders, plots every record the site counts or states which are left out, and point clicks open the right record. Partial: renders but clicks fail, records are silently missing, or it does not render for some readers. Does not apply: no text map is published.

discussions.label: Open questions
discussions.definition: Record pages show the record's open questions or knowledge gaps with their status, and an index links them across the corpus.
discussions.criteria: Present: records that carry discussions show them and a linked index lists them. Partial: shown on records but the index is unlinked or empty, or the index exists without record display. Does not apply: no record carries discussions.

curation_notice.label: Curation notice
curation_notice.definition: The site says how its records were produced (for example AI-assisted curation or import) and what each curation status means, including that a workflow status is not a human review where that is the case.
curation_notice.criteria: Present: stated on the landing page or footer and explained beside the status on record pages. Partial: one of the two only.

feedback_route.label: Report a problem
feedback_route.definition: Each record page offers a route to report an error or suggest an edit, such as a prefilled GitHub issue or an edit link for the record's file.
feedback_route.criteria: Present: every record page has a working route. Partial: a site-wide route only, or one that does not identify the record.

corpus_stats.label: Corpus statistics
corpus_stats.definition: The landing page shows generated corpus counts.

category_browse.label: Category browsing
category_browse.definition: Category or class pages lead into subsets of the corpus.
category_browse.criteria: Partial: categories are reachable only as a filter, or their index is not linked from the landing page.

suite_nav.label: Suite link
suite_nav.definition: A visible link to the X-Mech Suite directory at culturebotai.github.io/mechs/.

breadcrumbs.label: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.definition: Record and subset pages show a linked trail back to the listing and the record's category or parent.
breadcrumbs.criteria: Present: every record page has a trail whose links resolve. Partial: some page types only, or links that do not resolve.

not_found_page.label: Not-found page
not_found_page.definition: A missing URL anywhere on the site returns HTTP 404 with the site's own page, offering navigation or search back into the site.
not_found_page.criteria: Present: missing URLs at the site root and under its page directories get the themed page with working recovery links. Partial: only some paths, or the page lacks the theme or recovery links. Missing: GitHub's generic 404.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.definition: A bulk machine-readable export of all records is linked from the site.
downloads.criteria: Partial: only the repository, per-record files, partial exports, or a bulk file that no page links. Missing: no data or repository link at all.

schema_docs.label: Schema docs
schema_docs.definition: LinkML schema documentation is published on or linked from the site.
schema_docs.criteria: Partial: the site says a schema exists but links only the repository root, or a documentation page exists that nothing links. Does not apply: there is no schema.

license.label: License
license.definition: The site states the data and code licenses, consistent with the repository's license files.
license.criteria: Partial: stated on only some pages, or inconsistent with the repository.

build_provenance.label: Build or version
build_provenance.definition: The site states when it was built, which commit it shows, or a dated version of its own records.
build_provenance.criteria: Partial: only the dates or releases of upstream sources.

theme_toggle.label: Theme toggle
theme_toggle.definition: A light and dark toggle whose choice carries across pages.
theme_toggle.criteria: Partial: follows the operating system's setting without a toggle, or some linked pages ignore the choice.

responsive.label: Narrow screens
responsive.definition: No horizontal page overflow at 390 pixels on pages linked from the main navigation, the browse page or record pages; wide tables scroll in their own region.
responsive.criteria: Partial: some of those pages overflow.

load_failure.label: Load errors
load_failure.definition: When a data request fails, the page shows an error rather than an empty or misleading result.
load_failure.criteria: Partial: some failures are silent or misleading. Does not apply: the pages fetch no data.

skip_link.label: Skip link
skip_link.definition: The first keyboard stop on each page is a link that skips to the main content.
skip_link.criteria: Present: landing, listing and record pages each start with a skip link whose target exists in main. Partial: some page types only.

visual_alternative.label: Text alternative for visuals
visual_alternative.definition: Every map, diagram or graph has a table or list alternative a keyboard or screen-reader user can reach, listing what the visual shows with record links.
visual_alternative.criteria: Present: every visual on the site has one. Partial: some visuals only. Does not apply: the site has no maps, diagrams or graphs.

no_js_fallback.label: Works without JavaScript
no_js_fallback.definition: With JavaScript disabled, the listing still reaches every record and record pages still show their content, or the page says plainly that it needs JavaScript.
no_js_fallback.criteria: Present: listing and record content render without JavaScript. Partial: record pages render but the listing is empty, or a page fails silently. Missing: blank pages with no message.
